H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H5401: to kiss, literally or figuratively (touch); also (as a mode of attachment), to equip with weapons
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H1730: (figuratively) to love; by implication, a love-token, lover, friend; specifically an uncle
H8081: grease, especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness
H7324: to pour out (literally or figuratively), i.e. empty
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H4900: to draw, used in a great variety of applications (including to sow, to sound, to prolong, to develop, to march, to remove, to delay, to be tall, etc.)

H4339: evenness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity or concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) rectitude (only in plural with singular sense; often adverbially)
H1323: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
H3389: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
H168: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
H6938: Kedar, a son of Ishmael; also (collectively) Bedouin (as his descendants or representatives)
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing

H7805: to tan (by sunburning); figuratively (as if by a piercing ray) to scan
H8121: the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H517: a mother (as the bond of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively (like father))
H2787: to glow, i.e. literally (to melt, burn, dry up) or figuratively (to show or incite passion)
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)

H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles

H5844: to wrap, i.e. cover, veil, cloth, or roll
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not

H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.

H3895: the cheek (from its fleshiness); hence, the jaw-bone
H8447: a succession, i.e. a string or (abstractly) order
H6677: the back of the neck (as that on which burdens are bound)
H2737: properly, pierced, i.e. a bead of pearl, gems or jewels (as strung)
H2091: gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H3701: silver (from its pale color); by implication, money
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H4524: a divan (as enclosing the room); abstractly (adverbial) around
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)

H4753: myrrh (as distilling in drops, and also as bitter)
H996: between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or
H7699: the breast of a woman or animal (as bulging)
H3885: to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain)
H811: a bunch of grapes or other fruit

H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H3123: a dove (apparently from the warmth of their mating)
H637: meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though
H5273: delightful (objective or subjective, literal or figurative)
H7488: verdant; by analogy, new; figuratively, prosperous

H730: a cedar tree (from the tenacity of its roots)
